landing.title: SkillBridge AI — AI Career Navigator for Students and Graduates
landing.hero_lede: Pick the job you want. SkillBridge AI compares your CV against what that role actually asks for, then builds a free step-by-step roadmap to close the gap — and points you at the job boards used where you live.
landing.hero_note: Your CV is read in memory to pull out skills, then discarded — we never store the file.
landing.mock_aria: Preview of a skill report: 74 percent match for Data Analyst, with SQL, Power BI and Statistics still missing, and a three-phase roadmap.
landing.step1_p: Drop in a PDF or DOCX. We read it, pull out your technical, soft and tool skills, and sort them for you.
landing.step2_p: Choose from {tracks} career tracks and see your match score, your strengths, and exactly what is missing.
landing.step3_p: Beginner to advanced phases, each missing skill paired with a free course, a video and somewhere to practise.
landing.step4_p: See which roles fit your current skills, and search them on the job boards people actually use in your country.
landing.features_sub: The parts that keep working after the first report.
landing.feat1_p: Ask what to learn next, how to word a CV line, which certifications are worth it, or how to prepare for an interview — answered against your own skill profile.
landing.feat2_p: Tick skills off as you learn them and watch your match score climb. Your dashboard remembers where you left off.
landing.feat3_h: A stronger CV, written for you
landing.feat3_p: Get concrete rewrite suggestions and download an improved CV as a PDF, with your strongest matching skills moved to the top.
landing.feat4_p: Job searches, certifications and licensing advice follow your own country — not one market the site happened to be built around.
landing.cta_heading: Ready to close your skill gap?
landing.cta_sub: Create your free profile in under a minute — or look at a finished report first.
